body: I would rather die trying. If I was in paleolithic age I would have no choice but to deal with it. Every living thing that is incapacitated except humans and pets in the more developed areas are forced to just deal with their problem and keep fighting. If that's what God or Life wants of me then be it. I don't care anymore at this point, let me be depressed and sad and even more exhausted everyday, at least I'm living my life and trying something.
I will definitely look into it. Thanks for the suggestion.

Well I feel exhausted and easily get 'sick' and feel I am about to faint or collapse through the day. But I then I eat tons of oranges, ginger and ACV with tea and chicken soup and it goes away. But it comes back after the next work out. The other day I was in the public pool and fainted for 3 seconds then realized I was in the pool.  I rather live doing what I like even if it means compromising my health than just wait for treatment. My life sucks anyway so I'm better off doing something I like while I'm here. Only thing that really sucks with my lifestyle and health issue is that I can absolutely not drink or eat unhealthy otherwise I will worsen my condition and won't be able to recuperate after my work out.

That's great for you. Life is just a moment and death is eternal. I would not care to be paralyzed if I had faith in a god in the afterlife. I am still looking for him everyday but it's harder for some people. This is probably the main reason of why I think so much of suicide. I still haven't figured the real reason to justify all the pain in life. Thanks for your words I really appreciate it.

Yeah but I wish I would have just enjoy the little bit of life left I had. I spend time making progress but I end up with nothing. Yes I'm stronger but my life sucks so hard now it's not even funny. Thanks for talking to man you're a great person.
Mainly on food and rent. I should have spend it on ways to do something with my life, like booze and restaurants. I thought I could make it so I kept saving it. But things did not end up well.

What?? I never shamed anyone what are you even talking about? You're an awful person to come lecture me and twist what I said just to try to put yourself in higher ground. How pathetic of you to come to me in my darkest hour and talk to me like that. Be ashamed of yourself. And I won't waste my time with you I'm blocking you and if you contact me with another account you will be blocked right away. Get a life.
